events.text:
The migration is complete. All 10 batches, 400 records total, are now in the new CRM.

One data issue came up during the run. The old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes, and the new CRM saved every number with a +1 prefix. That is wrong for overseas customers. Of the first 120 records, 31 are overseas and have incorrect numbers, and batches 4 through 10 have the same problem. Fourteen sales users have opened customer records in the last 24 hours, so some of them may already be working from bad numbers.
